scientific_integrity: Proof covers all integers n>=2, while the exact integer Weyl checker corroborates only n=1..10; source date is earliest public posting of focal cited 2021 work, not a date of this finding.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the symmetric-power/conjugate pair in SU(3) and the fourth moment; classical Pieri and Haar formulas are ingredients. An equivalent result in unindexed literature remains a historical-priority risk. No external independent audit has been conducted.
title: Exact two-sided fourth moments and ternary phase resonance for paired symmetric-power characters of \(SU(3)\)
